svg.title: I build AI-powered products and payment systems that stay correct when things go wrong.
svg.desc: Software Engineer and AI Engineer. Open to remote, part-time and freelance work. 20 projects built, 6 live apps, 800+ students led, 15 events hosted.

g.text: Open to remote, part-time and freelance work
stay correct when things go wrong.
AI that reads receipts, speech and scripture
ledgers the database refuses to let lie
one payment, however many times you ask
apps that keep working without signal
